# n0ught

> I build with AI. I build communities. I turn AI tools into working products fast, and I keep online spaces active, helpful, and worth coming back to.

Personal portfolio of the pseudonymous builder n0ught. One public page; all copy is self-reported by the site owner. Contact: https://x.com/n0xght (DMs on X).

## Core pages

- [Home](https://n0ught.me/index.md): I build with AI. I build communities. Stance, what I bring, five project cards, route so far, current loadout and contact.

## Projects (external)

- [GeoScout](https://geoscout.pages.dev): A city report when you need one, not after you’ve forgotten why. Cached for speed; 100/100 Lighthouse accessibility and SEO.
- [JustHireMe](https://just-hire-me.pages.dev): Job listings love jargon. Paste one in and get a clearer read on what the role actually wants.
